tools.description: Raise a finding on a merge request as a peer, not as the review bot. It opens its own thread, counts against the merge gate like any other, and a later review may not close it — the review can say the code looks fixed, but only a person closes it. Needs the project's operator token. Use for a problem you found that the reviewer did not.

filePath.description: Path as it appears in the diff; omit for a finding about the whole change

line.description: Line in the new file; omit to leave it unanchored

severity.description: BLOCKER, MAJOR or MINOR. Defaults to MAJOR.

tools.name: create_finding

tools.description: Read one memory document by id, including its markdown body.

id.description: The document id from search_memory or list_memories

tools.name: get_memory

tools.description: Fetch one merge-request cycle: live status, every review, every finding, every reply summary, and the event log saying how each finding reached the state it is in and who moved it.
tools.name: get_merge_request

tools.description: Fetch one review in full, including the prompt sent to the model, the agent trace (turns and tool calls), and the review it produced. Use to inspect why a review said what it said.
tools.name: get_review

tools.description: List memory documents in a project, optionally restricted to a space (project, mrs, notes). Summaries without bodies.
tools.name: list_memories

tools.description: List the live status of merge requests mrr has reviewed in a project. Use get_merge_request for the timeline and findings.
tools.name: list_merge_request_cycles

tools.description: List the currently open merge requests for a registered project, as reported by its forge. Use when you need to know what is in flight.

projectId.description: The mrr project id, from list_projects

tools.name: list_merge_requests

tools.description: List the projects registered with mrr that you have access to. Call this first to find the project id needed by the other tools.
tools.name: list_projects

tools.description: List recent AI reviews, newest first. Returns summaries without the prompt, response, or trace bodies — call get_review for those.

projectId.description: Restrict to one project id; omit for all you can see

tools.name: list_reviews

tools.description: Re-run a finished review against the same commit — for example after editing the project's review instructions. Returns immediately; poll get_review until state is READY or FAILED.
tools.name: rerun_review

tools.description: Review a merge request now, as the forge has it, without waiting for a webhook or the periodic scan. Works on a request mrr has never seen. Not a re-review: asking twice on an unchanged commit returns the review that already exists and spends nothing — use rerun_review to force a fresh pass over the same commit. Drafts are reviewed.

projectId.description: The mrr project id, from list_projects

tools.name: review_merge_request

tools.description: Search a project's OKF memory. Returns id — kind — title — tags, never full bodies. Use get_memory to read one document.

query.description: Text to match in title, subject, or tags

tools.name: search_memory

tools.description: Move a finding by hand. WONT_FIX: real, and nobody is fixing it — you go on the record as having accepted the risk. DUPLICATE: another finding covers it. APPROVED: accepted as it stands. OPEN: reopen it. DISPUTED is not a state — it records a disagreement and leaves the finding open and counting. ADDRESSED cannot be set: it means a commit fixed the problem, which is a review's verdict to reach.

note.description: Why — kept on the finding's history

state.description: OPEN, APPROVED, WONT_FIX, DUPLICATE, or DISPUTED

tools.name: set_finding_state

tools.description: Replace the body of the review comment mrr posted on the merge request. Use to correct or amend a review in place rather than adding a second comment.

markdown.description: The new comment body, in the forge's flavour of Markdown

reviewId.description: The review id whose posted comment should be edited

tools.name: update_comment
